items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: So our monitor guy, Mike, also will do some adjustments during and listening to the mix... Mike’s only been with us for a few months now but we’ve already dialed in to a point where he knows what to listen for and change it.

ctx.x: Yeah. The look. So we all run our own mixes but I assume they’re all pretty similar in the sense of we take what we need to get dialed first and then we’ll kind of bring in —

Yeah. What we need is different. For me one of the struggles I’ve had over time is, especially when we all build up really loudly in jams, hearing when Greg, our rhythm guitarist, is switching keys or like moving maybe up a progression, and so I’ve had to make sure to dial that in while still not having too much of it like when he goes into his wah to kind of overwhelm things. So our monitor guy, Mike, also will do some adjustments during and listening to the mix just like our front of the house sound guy does…

It’s very common to be watching a band and you see one of the musicians look offstage at the monitor person and they point to the monitor and then they go like this right? People hardly ever point to the monitor and go like give me less. It always just seems like more, give me more.
